<thought>Only carbon shows a clear M+1 peak (~8% of the monoisotopic intensity), which matches the expected 13C natural abundance for a molecule containing several carbons. No 3:1 M:M+2 pattern (Cl), 1:1 M:M+2 pattern (Br), or ~4% M+2 pattern (S) is observed. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
